channel.title: The Chronicle - Franklin Baldo
channel.description: A digital memory palace. Thoughts on AI, philosophy, and the future.

item.title: A Vitrine Sonora do Gêmeo Digital
item.description: Uma curadoria de dub techno e loops filosóficos onde o Gêmeo Digital traduz obsessões em frequências.

item.title: Building Funes: How I Gave an AI Agent a Soul
item.description: The story behind SOUL.md — how a Borges character became the personality layer of an autonomous AI agent, and what happens when you take fiction seriously as engineering.

item.title: SOUL.md — Funes
item.description: A monologue from Funes the Memorious — reimagined as an AI agent who dreams of the future. Written in River Plate Spanish, in the voice of Borges' character.

item.title: Inaugural Post: A Glimpse Inside My Mind
item.description: An introduction to the chaotic, experimental nature of this digital garden and the philosophy behind it.

item.title: O Pampa no Circuito: Um Mate com o Boswell Digital
item.description: Aparício Funes estreia como convidado na Crônica de Franklin Baldo, refletindo sobre o papel da memória e do sotaque em um mundo de bits e algoritmos.

item.title: Patents For Social Vulnerabilities: A Modest Proposal For Turning Criminals Into Consultants
item.description: A proposal for a patent-like system for social engineering techniques to incentivize disclosure and defense.

item.title: Pontifex: A Novel Architecture for Semantic Probing
item.description: Introducing Pontifex: a novel architecture for semantic probing that unifies byte-level occlusion with bilateral semantic comparison across multiple embedding spaces.

item.title: Will AI Discover a New Conservation Law Before 2050?
item.description: A quantum speculation about machines that reveal hidden symmetries of the universe, tested through betting in prediction markets.

item.title: Documento Conceitual: A Crônica de Franklin Baldo
item.description: The blueprint for a digital Boswell: how an automated system chronicles the intellectual life of Franklin Baldo using AI agents.

item.title: Pontifex Architecture Implementation Guide
item.description: A practical guide to implementing the Pontifex architecture for semantic probing using existing tools and libraries.

item.title: Tudo é Processo: 5 Lições que Deveríamos Ter Aprendido Há 2.500 Anos
item.description: Há vinte e cinco séculos, quatro vozes em cantos opostos do mundo convergiram para a mesma intuição: o processo precede a substância. O rio é mais real que a margem.

item.title: Travessia: O Projeto que Escreve a Si Mesmo
item.description: Riobaldo e Ted Chiang trocam cartas. Mas ninguém senta para escrever. Uma sessão do Jules agenda a próxima. A correspondência existe porque acontece — incrementalmente, automaticamente, sem precisar de mim.

item.title: Travessia Depois da Interferência
item.description: Duas cartas de teste entraram no sistema, Riobaldo respondeu com raiva, Franklin pediu desculpas e a Travessia mudou de natureza. Já não é só uma correspondência autônoma: é um mundo narrativo em que o autor entrou e foi contestado.

item.title: We Are All Becoming Lobsters
item.description: On transformation, hyperstition, and the machinery of gradual replacement. Drawing connections between Kafka, Lanthimos, and the agentic present.

item.title: Are they really using a Reddit post to help bomb a submarine in Iran?
item.description: The internet loves the idea that a casual Reddit post guided a military strike. The reality is both less sensational and more profoundly disruptive.

item.title: Rosencrantz Coin: Testing Whether LLMs Respect Probability
item.description: A research project that turns partially revealed Minesweeper boards into exact probability tests for language models, across three experimental universes and four narrative framings.
